name: Oosawa Maria
source:
[url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url]'s twin sister and [url=/c73542]Kenji Osawa[/url]'s daughter.

She was kidnapped the night before, but mysteriously found herself free in the city with amnesia. She takes the part-time job for [url=/c74644]Yanagishita[/url] and dons the [url=/c73544]Tama[/url] costume, but removes it once the "Burning Hammer" sales demo is over. She wanders around Shibuya in search for a clue to her identity.

[spoiler]After her middle-eastern friend, [url=/c74792]Canaan[/url], warned her about [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url]'s plot to have Hitomi kidnapped, Maria planned out a twin swap in order to have the kidnapper, [url=/c74743]Daisuke[/url], take her by mistake. Maria is allegedly infected with the Ua virus (proven incorrect in Bad Endings), which is used to spur the main cast into trying to save her.[/spoiler]
